## This Repo
Website (Vite + React + Tailwind). Content via DuckDB CMS (JSON at build-time).
- CMS data: `../cms/data/synapticore-studio/` (cloned in CI)
- Icons: Lucide React — string names in JSON, lookup objects in JSX
- Styling: `#020202` bg, Orange/Cyan Gradienten, System sans, italic uppercase

## Conventions
- UI: Deutsch — Tags/Code: English
- Enterprise Claims ehrlich framen (Track Record, nicht aktive Projekte)
- VWAG = Volkswagen Group (nicht "VW Konzern", nicht "VAG")
- DCC/Production Fokus, nicht Software Development
